name: Bovine Colostrum
summary: Bovine colostrum is first-milk powder marketed for gut barrier, immunity, and athletic recovery at premium prices. A 2024 meta-analysis of 10 RCTs found significantly reduced intestinal permeability (PMID 38361147). Trials used ~20 g/day while commercial products typically sell 1-3 g per serving - a major dose gap the category does not advertise.
description: Canonical bovine colostrum research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until the studied-dose vs sold-dose gap is documented, product quality variance is characterized, and exercise vs clinical-population boundaries are explicit, passing the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: intestinal permeability; mucosal immunity; growth factor signaling
